# Healthy Kids, Healthy Future

> A comprehensive resource platform supporting early childhood education providers in implementing evidence-based nutrition and physical activity programs to prevent childhood obesity and promote healthy development.

Healthy Kids, Healthy Future (HKHF) provides training, resources, and technical assistance to early care and education (ECE) providers across multiple states. The organization partners with programs like CACFP, Go NAPSACC, and Nemours Children's Health to deliver professional development and implement systems change initiatives.

## Key Topics

- Early Childhood Education (ECE)
- Child and Adult Care Food Program (CACFP)
- Physical Activity
- Healthy Eating
- ECE Providers
- Nutrition Programs
- Technical Assistance
- Breastfeeding Support
- Family Child Care
- Go NAPSACC
- Better Together
- Healthy Habits
- Child Health
- Learning Collaboratives
- Training Resources

## Core Program & Framework

- [Healthy Kids, Healthy Future](https://healthykidshealthyfuture.org): Homepage promoting healthy habits in early childhood education and nutrition
- [About Us](https://healthykidshealthyfuture.org/about): Organization mission and overview of HKHF programs and goals
- [5 Healthy Goals](https://healthykidshealthyfuture.org/5-healthy-goals): Five healthy goals framework for childhood obesity prevention and healthy habits

## Training & Professional Development

- [Trainers](https://healthykidshealthyfuture.org/trainers): Trainer resources and professional development for ECE providers
- [Better Together](https://healthykidshealthyfuture.org/trainers/better-together): Better Together project resources for ECE policy and systems change
- [Webinar Series: ECE Nutrition and Physical Activity Resource Showcase](https://healthykidshealthyfuture.org/links/news-updates/webinar-series-ece-nutrition-and-physical-activity-resource-showcase): Webinar series showcasing ECE nutrition and physical activity resources

## Resources for ECE Providers

- [Family Child Care Healthy Goal Resources](https://healthykidshealthyfuture.org/family-child-care-resources): Resources for family child care providers on nutrition and healthy eating
- [En Español](https://healthykidshealthyfuture.org/en-espanol): Spanish-language resources for early childhood education and child health
- [Promoting Healthy Practices in ECE through Breastfeeding Support in Kansas](https://healthykidshealthyfuture.org/links/promoting-healthy-practices-in-ece-through-breastfeeding-support-in-kansas): Kansas breastfeeding support initiative and toolkit for child care providers
